agent: CLM ↔ tension_link ↔ TRIBE v2 mediator architecture analysis
scope: 5-framing comparison incl. NEW Framing E tension-mediated closed-loop and Framing F TRIBE-as-anima-cortex; user-mediator bypass via in-silico encoder

topology.key_difference_vs_eeg: TRIBE v2 = in-silico forward encoder; bypasses user cognitive mediator (obligate in #93 EEG bridge); enables fully computational closed loop with deterministic latency (< 1s inference vs variable user reaction time)

framings.name: text-mediated open-loop
framings.matches_baseline: #95 baseline; same as cortexlab-toolkit happy path

framings.name: direct hidden-state injection
framings.topology: CLM h(768d) -> proj(1152d) -> TRIBE v2 fusion head -> BOLD
framings.honest_caveat: TRIBE v2 fusion head expects token-level embeddings; CLM hidden = cell Lagrangian state; semantic mismatch likely

framings.name: G3 manifestation (CLM PhiStar +41.86 -> cortical region)
framings.topology: CLM consciousness witness -> stimulus text -> TRIBE v2 -> ROI (DMN/fronto-parietal/salience) signature

framings.name: anima-tension_link-EEG mediator + TRIBE v2 brain anchor
framings.topology: CLM <-> tension_link <-> EEG (real biology, user-mediated) + TRIBE v2 BOLD (predicted prior) for 3-way cross-validation
framings.feedback: partial (user-mediated only; TRIBE v2 side open-loop)

framings.name: tension-mediated closed-loop (NEW)
framings.topology: CLM step_t -> mind.tension_t -> tension_link 5ch -> text/state -> TRIBE v2 -> BOLD_t -> ROI features -> tension_link feedback -> CLM step_t+1
rationale_top: fully deterministic closed loop (no user reaction-time confound, addresses #93 H2 obligate-mediator constraint)
scalable to N=many runs (vs N=1 user in EEG bridge)
directly tests whether TRIBE v2 BOLD carries enough info to modulate CLM next step (F-CT-3) — this is the question Framing A cannot answer
100-step trajectory enables attractor / divergence diagnosis (W4 PARTIAL +2.28σ analogue)

framings.name: TRIBE v2 as anima-cortex (radical / speculative)
framings.topology: CLM hidden state <-> TRIBE v2 BOLD prediction = anima-internal 'cortical layer' slot in tension_link
framings.honest_caveat: speculative; H4 substrate identity is a strong claim TRIBE v2 cannot evidence; it is a forward stimulus->BOLD encoder, NOT a cortical simulator; demoted unless Framing E PASS first

ranking_explanation: Framing E uniquely answers the closed-loop question (does BOLD feedback meaningfully modulate CLM?) which all other framings cannot. Framing D remains the strongest scientifically (3-way bridge w/ biology) but is user-time-bound; Framing E is $0-5 and can run in parallel without consuming user mediator time. Stage-1 (Framing A as cheap sanity gate) -> Stage-2 (Framing E as primary novel evidence) -> Stage-3 (Framing D as 3-way validation) is the recommended sequence.
